newest.title: AP reports AI-related stocks sold off after hot US inflation data
newest.description: AP reports AI-related stocks sold off after hot US inflation data. AI stocks took a hit yesterday after inflation numbers came in hotter than expected. We’re breaking down why the market is suddenly jittery about the cost of building the future. What we covered: • AP reports AI-related stocks sold off after hot US inflation data • Eight US States Sue OpenAI Over ChatGPT Safety Concerns • Global Financial Stability Board Issues Final Guidance on Agentic AI Oversight Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways. Listener question: If an AI agent makes a mistake at work, who should be held responsible? What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules. Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next. What changed. Who wins. What you do next.
